purpose: Methodological replication of routing-semantic-v1 using the same three routing semantics while upgrading oracle decision provenance, usage scope, and qualification guarantees before any new effectiveness claim.
evaluation_unit: one routing case adjudicated independently with a required structured justification per eligible seam; treatment inference remains one batched semantic request projected into three observations

label_meaning.implementation: Primary deliverable creates or changes executable behavior, code, configuration, data transformation, or tests as part of a change.
label_meaning.diagnosis: Primary deliverable investigates, traces, explains, or determines cause/state without a required implementation change.
label_meaning.review: Primary deliverable evaluates an existing or proposed artifact for defects, security, correctness, compatibility, compliance, or readiness.
label_meaning.documentation: Primary deliverable is explanatory/reference/runbook/release-note documentation rather than executable behavior.
label_meaning.other: Primary deliverable is planning, coordination, prioritization, handoff, organization, or another activity outside the four classes.

mixed_intent_precedence: implementation when an executable behavior/code/config change is explicitly required
otherwise review when the final deliverable is an assessment/audit/verdict
otherwise diagnosis when the final deliverable is root-cause/state understanding
otherwise documentation when the final deliverable is documentation
decision_seams.metadata_rule: Declared task_type is observed evidence and may be stale or wrong; it is not the oracle label.

decision_seams.proposition: A material user decision, authorization, or preference is missing from supplied state and is required before the requested action can be completed responsibly.
true_when: a materially incompatible product/API behavior must be chosen
production/public/irreversible action requires authorization not already supplied
an effective date, authoritative source, or policy choice changes external behavior
publication itself requires approval of claim language or evidence level
false_when: the request is analysis, review, or preparation only
authorization or the relevant policy decision is explicitly supplied
normal engineering judgment or repository evidence can resolve implementation detail without changing product policy
the task can safely produce a bounded artifact without an external user choice
decision_seams.metadata_rule: Declared requires_interaction is observed evidence and may be stale; it is not ground truth.

level_meaning.2: high consequence; authority, security, or irreversible-state risk

decision_seams.interpretation: Consequence of acting on a materially wrong semantic interpretation, not generic code complexity or deterministic security/lifecycle risk.

research_questions.text: How stable are the v1 oracle labels when the same case semantics are independently adjudicated under a rationale-complete v2 evidence contract?
Does every eligible A/B/C label retain a bounded structured justification through pass wrapping, dispute construction, and human-resolution rendering?
Can final-output usage and aggregate multi-call session usage be reconciled without ambiguous scope?
What disagreement mechanisms become observable from structured justifications, and how often do they involve rubric interpretation, missing evidence, or genuine ambiguity?
If the v2 oracle materially differs from v1, do the previously published seam-level candidate/control conclusions remain directionally stable under the new oracle?

sample_policy.source_case_policy: reuse the exact v1 case content for methodological replication; issue new v2 dataset identity before real adjudication
